name: Brker Basketball
summary:
# BRKER is a free mixed reality basketball experience for Meta Quest, bringing arcade action to your real-world court.

Pick up a REAL basketball, enable HAND tracking, and ROOM-scale boundary, and navigate through high-speed obstacle courses in your living room, the gym, or shaded outdoor spaces.
